bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 164, Number 104 (Thursday, June 21, 2018)]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. TAKANO:
H.R. 6189.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
This bill is introduced under the powers granted to
Congress under Article 1 of the Constitution.
[Page H5506]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and the Workforce, and in addition to the Committee on Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
